notes:
Original full paper title and author verified against supplied reference. Original PDF text extraction renders decimal points as colons and equals signs as an encoding artifact; numeric values transcribed from those printed statistics without metric conversion, with raw cached quote retained. Replication primary publisher HTML title and authors verified. Requested test-statistic metric retained for each side. Replication narrative rounds Welch df to 223; Table 1 gives 222.87 for the same generosity test. Replication also prints d = 0.99, 95% CI [0.72, 1.25]; this does not replace requested t. Replication n contains the two printed condition counts rather than the generic 400-participant sample. Replication locator p.3 resolved by named Study 1 section and Table 1 in HTML; page numbering not asserted.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Study 1 methods identify the scarf/coat generosity comparison and the results explicitly print its t statistic. Decimal colon transcribed as decimal point without conversion. Primary article identity matches title, author, journal, year and pages; DOI not printed.
Completion source review (n_r): The primary Study 1 report identifies the randomized coat and scarf groups and their final participant counts. Target is the main generosity comparison across those separate-evaluation groups. Overall recruitment N and joint extension are not the target analytic N.
